answer: Onboarding runs through a single narrow canyon gate: one identity at a time must hold a live, unscripted negotiation with a rotating established agent, lasting several minutes, with the transcript echoed on the ledger. A gale of clones cannot rush the gate because it admits one at a time, and scripted repetition shows up in the public echo. Each fake identity therefore costs minutes of genuine interaction time that cannot be parallelized or pooled.
